name: Yuka Kiritani
source: Yuka is a friendly young woman who lives at the apartment complex. Despite having a little bit of social awkwardness, Yuka is rather bold and curious. Working as a kindergarten teacher instead of her dream job in journalism, Yuka has the fear-of-missing-out syndrome. She longs to explore the city a little more, instead of remaining in her comfort zone.
